data.source: PropBetEdge archive of final WNBA box scores (source: ESPN), KV game:v1:final:<game_id>
unavailable: pressure_clutch: play-by-play is archived but per-player clutch attribution is not built in V1
career: the archive holds the 2026 season only; career DNA is not calculated or rendered
shot location, tracking, defensive matchup and on/off data are not stored; creation, shooting profile, free-throw pressure, defensive activity and matchup adaptability are labelled proxies
winba: the canonical WinBA board is attached unchanged; it currently counts the 2026 All-Star Game (ESPN 401857320), which every other DNA dimension excludes (open owner finding)
injury status and Player Load are not inputs

dimensions.label: Scoring
dimensions.desc: Points per 36 minutes and per game

dimensions.label: Creation
dimensions.proxy_reason: No unassisted-shot or pull-up data; usage rate and assists stand in for creation

dimensions.label: Efficiency
dimensions.desc: True shooting and effective field goal percentage

dimensions.label: Shooting profile
dimensions.proxy_reason: No shot-location data; three-point volume and shooting percentages only

dimensions.label: Free-throw pressure
dimensions.proxy_reason: Foul-drawing and two-point volume only. This is NOT rim pressure: no player paint, rim-attempt or shot-location data is stored

dimensions.label: Defensive activity
dimensions.proxy_reason: Box-score events only (steals, blocks, fouls). No matchup, on/off or tracking data; this measures activity, not defensive impact
dimensions.desc: Steals and blocks per 36, fouls per 36 (inverted)

dimensions.label: Pressure / clutch
dimensions.desc: Play-by-play is archived, but per-player clutch attribution is not built or validated in V1

dimensions.label: Playoff translation
dimensions.desc: Game Score per 36 and TS% in archived postseason games minus archived regular season

dimensions.label: Role
dimensions.desc: Minutes per game (bigger role, not better)

dimensions.label: Availability
dimensions.desc: Games played / archived team games between first and last appearance for that team. Box-score appearances only; no injury data

dimensions.label: Form
dimensions.desc: Last 10 games of the scope minus the whole scope (Game Score per 36)

dimensions.label: Matchup adaptability
dimensions.proxy_reason: Team-level opponent strength only (opponent record before the game); no individual matchup data
dimensions.desc: Game Score per 36 vs .500+ opponents minus overall

dimensions.label: Volatility
dimensions.desc: Game-to-game spread of Game Score (higher = more volatile, not better)

dimensions.label: WinBA
dimensions.desc: Canonical winba/1.0.0 board score, attached unchanged (season scope only)

method.percentile: mid-rank within the qualified players of the same scope and as_of

decisions.history_seasons: none (2026 archive only); career DNA is never rendered

winba.note: The canonical WinBA board counts ESPN regular-season game(s) that the other DNA dimensions exclude as non-team fixtures: 401857320. Open owner finding; WinBA v1 is unchanged.
